Thou art good Veluet; thou'rt a three [[piled|pild]]-piece I warrant thee: I had as [[lief]]e be a '''Lyſt''' of an Engliſh [[kersey|Kerſey]], as be pil'd, as thou art pil'd, for a French Veluet. Do I ſpeake feelingly now?|translation=''1st Gentleman''. Well, you and I are [[cut from the same cloth]]. / ''Lucio''.
